magnus10_defining_system.txt
Defining polynomial system and high-precision solution for the order-10 centered Magnus
quadrature formula (Eq. 3) of
  K. C. Johnson, "Magnus quadrature formulas of order 10 on a centered interval,"
  Version 02-Nov-2026, magnus_order_10.pdf, https://github.com/kjinnovation/explde
Author: Kenneth C. Johnson, ken@kjinnovation.com. Prepared with the assistance of Claude Opus 5.5
(Anthropic), 02-Nov-2026.

Coefficients x1..x81 are numbered as in Eq. 3 and Appendix A of the paper (also the vector x
returned by magnus10coef.m). 25 of them are exact rationals (listed first); the other 56 are the
unknowns of the polynomial system below.

Equations E1..E70: for each Lyndon word of odd weight 3..9 in the letters g0..g4 (letter gk has
weight k+1), the coefficient of that word in the expansion of g0 + sum_i c_i*C_i (Eq. 3, with
C_i = X_i*Y_i - Y_i*X_i), minus its coefficient in the exact series of Omega in the centered
Legendre moments, equals zero. The rational coefficients are substituted. Each equation has exact
rational coefficients; * is multiplication and ^ a power. The system is consistent and
overdetermined (70 equations, 56 unknowns); its Jacobian has full column rank 56 (condition number
about 2.0e8), so the solution is isolated.

Solution: refined by Gauss-Newton iteration in 320-digit arithmetic (largest residual about
1e-318) and given here to 200 significant digits. Substituting these values gives residuals of
about 1e-198, limited by the rounding to 200 digits.

Position "Xi, gk" means the coefficient of gk in the operand X_i of C_i; "Omega, Ci" means c_i.
